Coram : SANJAY KAROL*, PRASHANT KUMAR MISHRA
Issue for Consideration Issue arose as regards the lack of compliance of s.146 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 which requires all vehicles to have a valid insurance policy covering third-parties; whether there should be a uniform motor-vehicle policy structure covering all occupants of to the statutorily mandated coverage of third- party risks; whether the High Court rightly allowed the appeal filed by the respondents-claimants holding that the policy in question was a comprehensive policy and would cover the owner of the vehicle as well, who was travelling in the car as a
Decision Date : 04-08-2026 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 14369/2025 | Direction Issue : Directions issued; matter to be listed on 18.08.2026 for perusal of affidavits of compliance. | Bench : 2 Judges
